digest.component_or_area: interfaces tier, write-op adapters (library / CLI / MCP)
propositions: Write operations (transition/claim/create) are exposed through three adapters (Python lib, CLI, MCP server) with hand-mirrored input surfaces, creating silent drift risk when parameters are missing on one adapter but present on another.

A behavioral conformance oracle suite must mechanically assert parity across all three adapters for the sanctioned write-op parameter surface (force/reason/close_class/caused_by/ref) without LLM-based detection or manual NxM maintenance matrices.

Runtime conditional rules (close_class required for bug-close, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be enforced behaviorally and consistently across all adapters, catching both param exposure divergence and rejection-rule divergence.

Known MCP parameter gaps (reason/caused_by/force on transition and claim) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, enabling the suite to pass in CI today while signaling forced cleanup when scratchy lands and rows flip to xpass.

The oracle reuses and extends the existing three-adapter harness (Outcome + Adapter protocol + implementations) rather than creating parallel drivers, threading write-op inputs through the shared transport layer.
Adapter-bound internals (source/return_alias/_creation_channel/repo_root) are excluded from the contract and verified not to produce false divergences via a negative-control row.
